app.name: NarzędziownikGP
app.description: Site management for construction companies: equipment, people, time on site, costs and fleet

login.title: Sign in
login.accountBlocked: This account has been deactivated. Contact the company owner.

changePassword.title: Set your own password
changePassword.intro: You signed in with a temporary password. Before you continue, set a password only you know.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.intro: Enter the email you sign in with. We'll send a link to set a new password.
resetPassword.noEmail: Do you sign in with a username and no email? Ask the company owner for a new temporary password.
resetPassword.sent: If this email has an account, you'll get a message with a link shortly. The link is valid for one hour.
resetPassword.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
resetPassword.invalidLink: The link has expired or was already used. Send a new one.

newPassword.title: New password
newPassword.intro: Set a new password for your account.

board.title: What's where
board.snapshot: No connection. State from {when}: what this phone downloaded last.
board.baseEmpty: There are no tools at the Base yet.
board.siteEmpty: There are no tools on this site yet.
board.vehicleEmpty: There are no tools in this vehicle yet.
board.toolReportsWaiting: Reported tools waiting for a decision: {count}

siteMap.title: Map
siteMap.hint: Click a site or a device with a tracker to see details.
siteMap.note: Demo version: site locations and tracker signals are examples.
siteMap.offline: The map needs an internet connection. The rest of the board works offline.
siteMap.failed: Couldn't load the map. Try refreshing the page.
siteMap.liveHint: Click a pin to see site details.
siteMap.ownerHint: Click a pin to see details. If a pin is in the wrong place, drag it to where the site is.
siteMap.movePin: Pick a new place on the map
siteMap.placing: Click on the map where {name} is.
siteMap.unplacedHint: These places aren't on the map because we couldn't find their address.
siteMap.unplacedOwnerHint: These places aren't on the map because we couldn't find their address. Fix the address or pick the place on the map.

search.title: Where's the tool?
search.label: What are you looking for?
search.hint: The list narrows as you type. Click a tool to see its card with history.
search.voiceHint: Hold and say what you're looking for, e.g. “where's the level?”. We delete the recording right after recognizing the text.
search.noMatches: Nothing matches “{query}”. Try a code, brand or another name.
search.heardNothing: I couldn't find a tool in “{text}”. Say it differently or type a name or code.
search.silence: I didn't hear anything. Hold the button and say what you're looking for.
search.failed: Couldn't understand the question. Type what you're looking for.
search.failedHeard: I heard “{text}”, but didn't understand the question. Type what you're looking for.

changeLog.title: Change log
changeLog.intro: Who created an account, deactivated a person or account, set a temporary password, anonymized a person or changed company settings, and when. Entries can't be changed or deleted; after a person is anonymized, a placeholder name replaces their name.
changeLog.limit: Showing the {count} newest entries. All of them are in the full company data export.
changeLog.settingsHint: Who created an account, deactivated a person, set a temporary password or changed company settings, and when.

settings.zgloszenia_kierownik: Site manager sees issues for their locations
settings.koszty_kierownik: Site manager sees costs for their locations

team.usernameHint: For signing in, e.g. jan.kowalski: lowercase letters without Polish characters, digits, dot, hyphen.
team.workerHint: A worker sees where equipment is but doesn't record movements. They sign in with a username, so no email is needed.
team.passwordHint: Hand it over in person. You won't see it again. At first sign-in this person will set their own password.
team.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate account: {name}? This person won't be able to sign in, but their movement history stays in the system.
team.recorderSeats: {count} of {limit} people recording movements. Free seats: {left}.
team.recorderSeatsHint: The owner, site managers and storekeepers count. You can add workers without limit.
team.recorderLimitReached: All seats in the {tier} plan are taken: {count} of {limit} people recording movements. To add a site manager or storekeeper you need the {upgrade} plan ({people}), with a setup surcharge of {surcharge} gross. You can add workers without limit, and you can also free a seat by deactivating an unused account.
team.recorderLimitContact: Arrange a higher plan with GP Engineering:

anonymize.confirm: Anonymize: {name}? This can't be undone. A placeholder name will replace their name, and the note, qualifications with documents, email, login, account, notifications and support chat will be removed. Movements, issues and clock-ins stay under the placeholder name. Only do this at this person's request.

people.title: People
people.intro: Everyone in the company: accounts in the app and people without an account, e.g. workers without a phone. A person without an account doesn't sign in and doesn't take a seat in the plan, and you can create an account for them later without a second entry.
people.addHint: No account, so no sign-in and no seat in the plan.
people.giveAccount: Create an account for this person
people.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate: {name}? The person will disappear from active people but stay in the records with their full history.
people.deleteDataHint: At this person's request (the “Delete account” page), delete their personal data within 30 days of the request. The history stays under a placeholder name.

kinds.badania_wysokosc: Medical check for work at height

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.myIntro: Your medical checks, training and qualifications with expiry dates. 30 days before expiry you'll get a reminder in notifications. New dates are entered by the owner or site manager.
qualifications.myEmpty: You don't have any qualifications entered yet.
qualifications.managerIntro: Medical checks, health and safety training and qualifications of everyone in the company. After training, enter the new date and attach the certificate; for medical checks you only see when they expire.
qualifications.upcomingEmpty: Nothing has expired and nothing expires in the next {days} days.
qualifications.inactive: This person has left the company: no new qualifications are entered and there are no reminders about them.
qualifications.empty: This person doesn't have any qualifications entered yet.
qualifications.emptyManager: Add a medical check, health and safety training or a qualification with an expiry date. 30 days before it expires the owner will get a reminder, and so will the person if they have an account.
qualifications.medicalHint: For medical checks we only store the date. Only the owner adds and sees the medical certificate.
qualifications.cycleHint: E.g. 12 for annual training. When you enter a renewal, the new date is calculated automatically.
qualifications.deleteConfirm: Delete the qualification together with its documents? This can't be undone.
qualifications.doneOn: Date of training, check or exam
qualifications.nextDueHint: Empty: {months} mo. from the renewal date. Enter it if the certificate states a different date.
qualifications.nextDueNoCycle: This qualification has no cycle, so enter the date from the certificate.
qualifications.documentHint: Up to 4 MB. We'll shrink photos before uploading.
qualifications.kindsIntro: Types that aren't on the standard list, e.g. excavator operator. You and site managers can assign them to anyone.
qualifications.kindsEmpty: The company has no custom types yet.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.body: This account isn't assigned to any active company. Contact the company owner.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission for this operation.
errors.no_access: This account doesn't have access to any company.
errors.password_too_short: The password must be at least {min} characters.
errors.stale_session: The temporary password was changed after you signed in. Sign in again with the new temporary password from the owner.
errors.recovery_expired: The password reset link has expired. Send a new one from the sign-in screen.
errors.email_taken: This email already has an account.
errors.username_taken: This username is already taken in your company.
errors.recorder_limit: All seats for people recording movements in your plan are taken. Arrange a higher plan with GP Engineering; you can add workers without limit.
errors.code_taken: Another tool in the company already has this code.
errors.category_taken: A category with this name already exists.
errors.prefix_taken: Another category already has this prefix.
errors.invalid_manager: Only an active site manager or owner from your company can manage a site or vehicle.
errors.site_not_empty: There are still tools on the site. Return them to the Base or transfer them before you close it.
errors.vin_invalid: A VIN has 17 characters: digits and letters except I, O and Q.
errors.vehicle_not_empty: There are still tools in the vehicle. Return them to the Base or transfer them before you deactivate it.
errors.movement_conflict: Movement rejected: the tools' state changed in the meantime. Nothing was saved.
errors.not_undoable: This movement can't be undone. The owner will fix the records with a correction.
errors.undo_expired: More than 15 minutes have passed since the movement was saved. The owner will fix the records with a correction.
errors.undo_blocked: This movement can no longer be undone: its tools have moved since.
errors.invalid_tool_state: The tool is already in this state.
errors.import_invalid: The import has rows with errors. Fix the file and upload it again. Nothing was saved.
errors.not_reported: This report has already been reviewed.
errors.not_rented: This tool is owned, not rented, so it doesn't go back to a rental company.
errors.no_stickers: There are no tools to label: every tool in use already has a printed sticker.
errors.read_only: The company is in read-only mode, so this change won't be saved. The board, history and export work as usual.
errors.tool_required: Choose the tool that is damaged.
errors.photo_invalid: The photo must be JPG, PNG or WEBP and no larger than 4 MB.
errors.deadline_taken: This deadline already exists. Edit the existing one.
errors.qualification_taken: This person already has this qualification. Edit the existing one.
errors.qualification_kind_taken: This qualification type is already on the list.
errors.document_invalid: The document must be a PDF or a JPG, PNG or WEBP photo and no larger than 4 MB.
errors.poster_invalid: This poster code doesn't work: the poster is out of date or from another company. Ask the site manager for a new poster.
errors.poster_no_address: The Base has no poster without an address. Add the Base address in settings.
errors.punch_overlap: This time overlaps another clock-in by this person. Fix that clock-in first.
errors.message_required: Write a message or attach a photo.
errors.demo_locked: In the demo you can't deactivate an account or set a temporary password, so everyone can enter every role. Other changes in People work.
errors.demo_chat: In the demo the support chat is off, because everyone viewing the demo shares this role's account.
errors.demo_push: In the demo push notifications are off, because everyone viewing the demo shares this role's account.
errors.demo_delete: Demo companies aren't deleted from the panel. A new demo replaces it, and the previous one disappears on its own.
errors.delete_requires_read_only: Only a company in read-only mode can be deleted. Turn that mode on first, so the company can still export its data.
errors.delete_confirmation: The name you entered doesn't match the company name. Nothing was deleted.
errors.callback_busy: Couldn't save the number right now. Call us or write to us.

tools.name: Name
tools.noCategories: The company has no tool categories yet. Add the first one below.
tools.importLink: Have a list of tools in Excel? Import from file →

toolsPage.title: Tools
toolsPage.intro: All company equipment: where it is, for how many days and who's responsible for it. Click a tool to open its card with history.
toolsPage.withRetiredAndReturned: Also show retired and returned to rental company
toolsPage.empty: The company has no tools yet.

vehiclesPage.title: Vehicles
vehiclesPage.intro: Company vehicles: who drives them, what equipment is on board and which deadlines are coming up within {days} days. Click a vehicle to open its page.
vehiclesPage.empty: The company has no vehicles yet.
vehiclesPage.emptyOwner: The company has no vehicles yet. Add a crew van or a car to see equipment on board and keep track of insurance and inspections.
vehiclesPage.noDeadlines: No deadlines in the next {days} days.

toolReports.title: Reported tools
toolReports.intro: Site managers reported equipment bought for the site. It's already on the board and can be moved; accept it with a code and value, or reject it, e.g. if it's already in the records.
toolReports.commentPlaceholder: e.g. this is W-01 from the Base
toolReports.rejectHint: The tool will be retired, but its card and history will stay.
toolReports.noSites: You have no active site you can report a tool to.
toolReports.noCategories: The company has no tool categories yet. Ask the owner to add categories.
toolReports.reportHint: The tool will appear on your site right away as “reported”. The owner will fill in the value and accept the report.

categories.name: Category name
categories.prefixHint: 1–4 letters, e.g. S for grinders (S-01, S-02…).

toolCard.ownerActionsHint: History doesn't change: every change is a new history entry.
toolCard.damaged: Reported as damaged {ago}. Movements still work; the flag is cleared when it's received from service or by the owner.

locations.siteNameHint: A short name, e.g. Rataje. This is how the site will appear on the board.
locations.vehicleNameHint: E.g. Van WX 12345. This is how the vehicle will appear on the board and in checklists.
locations.vinHint: 17 characters from the registration certificate (field E).
locations.serviceNameHint: E.g. Hilti Service Poznań. Equipment under repair won't look lost.
locations.noServicesYet: The company has no service shops yet.
locations.addressChanged: Address changed. The map pin is now at the new address.
locations.vehicleAlarmHint: Off by default for vehicles: a fixed kit travels with the crew. Turn it on if equipment shouldn't stay in the vehicle.
locations.deactivateHint: E.g. after selling the van. The vehicle will disappear from the board, but its history will stay.
locations.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate vehicle {name}? It can't be restored afterwards.
locations.deactivateEmptyOnly: Only an empty vehicle can be deactivated. Return the equipment to the Base or transfer it.

deadlines.title: Deadlines
deadlines.emptyOwner: Add an inspection, calibration, UDT inspection or warranty end. A week before the deadline, you and the site manager of the location where the equipment is will get a reminder in notifications.
deadlines.invoiceHint: Only you can see the invoice, because it shows the price.
deadlines.cycleHint: E.g. 12 for annual calibration. When you enter completion, the next deadline is calculated automatically.
deadlines.deleteConfirm: Delete the deadline together with its documents? This can't be undone.
deadlines.nextDueHint: Empty: {months} mo. from the completion date. Enter it if the inspection report or certificate states a different date.
deadlines.nextDueNoCycle: This deadline has no cycle: without a date there will be no next deadline.
deadlines.documentHint: Up to 4 MB. We'll shrink photos before uploading.
deadlines.completedNoNext: Completion saved. There's no next deadline.
deadlines.pageIntro: Inspections, calibrations, UDT inspections, warranty ends and vehicle deadlines in the next {days} days, plus overdue ones. A reminder arrives in notifications a week before the deadline, and 30 days before for OC, AC and tachograph.
deadlines.pageEmpty: There are no deadlines in the next {days} days.
deadlines.boardDue: Equipment with a deadline in the next {days} days: {count} pcs
deadlines.nextDuePolicyHint: Empty: {months} mo. from the end of the current policy, or from the renewal date if it has already ended. Enter it if the new policy states a different date.

noToolsAt.budowa: There are no tools on this site.
noToolsAt.serwis: There are no tools at this service shop.
noToolsAt.pojazd: There are no tools in this vehicle.

checklist.damagedFromService: {code} is reported as damaged: receiving it from service will clear this flag.
checklist.warranty: {code}: under warranty until {day}. Report the repair to the service shop as a warranty repair.
checklist.inspectionOverdue: {code}: {kind} overdue since {day}. The movement will be saved anyway.
checklist.inspectionAfterService: {code}: after receiving it, enter the completion ({kind}) and next deadline on the card.
checklist.followUp: Enter the completion and next deadline:

textEntry.label: What are you taking or returning?
textEntry.placeholder: e.g. I'm taking two grinders and a hammer drill from the Base
textEntry.placeholderSite: e.g. I'm taking two grinders and a hammer drill to site {site}
textEntry.hint: Write a normal sentence or ask where equipment is (“where's the level?”). I'll show what I understood, and nothing is saved until you confirm ✓.
textEntry.siteNotAllowed: I understood site “{site}”, but you can't record this movement there. Choose a site.
textEntry.everything: Everything at: {place}. Remove from the list what you're not taking.
textEntry.everythingChooseFrom: Choose where you're taking from, and I'll select all equipment there.
textEntry.question: Which ones: “{phrase}”? Choose {count}.
textEntry.unavailable: “{phrase}”: {missing} pcs missing where you're taking from.
textEntry.misplaced: {code} is somewhere else. Remove it from the list or change the movement type or site.
textEntry.failed: Couldn't understand the entry. Try again or use the checklist.

voice.hint: Keep holding the button the whole time you speak. We delete the recording right after recognizing the text.
voice.ready: Microphone ready. Hold the button and speak.
voice.tooShort: Too short. Keep holding the button the whole time you speak.
voice.noPermission: No access to the microphone. Allow the microphone in your browser settings or type instead.
voice.noMicrophone: Couldn't turn on the microphone. Type instead or try again.
voice.silence: I didn't hear anything. Hold the button and say what you're taking or returning.
voice.failed: Couldn't recognize the recording. Try again or type instead.
voice.invalid: I can't read this recording (too long or unknown format). Record a shorter one or type instead.

scanner.cameraHint: Point the camera at the sticker. You can scan several stickers in a row.
scanner.cameraDenied: No permission to use the camera. Allow it in your browser settings or enter the code manually.
scanner.cameraUnavailable: The camera is unavailable. Enter the sticker code manually.
scanner.cameraInsecure: The camera only works on a page opened over HTTPS. Enter the sticker code manually.
scanner.unknownSticker: This tool isn't on the company board.
scanner.unknownCode: There's no tool with code {code} on the board.
scanner.empty: Scan stickers or enter codes. We'll suggest the movement type based on where the equipment is now.
scanner.cannotMove: You can't move this equipment. Remove it from the list.
scanner.conflictRefreshed: The list below has been refreshed. Check the movements and confirm again.

settings.title: Site alarm
settings.alarmThresholdHint: A tool that stays on a site longer than this many days (from being issued to the site) gets an alarm. From 1 to {max} days.
settings.invalidDays: Enter a number of days from 1 to {max}.
settings.baseAddressHint: With an address, the Base appears on the sites map on the board. Leave empty to keep it off the map.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.hint: Arrange plan changes and payments with GP Engineering. Accounts don't count toward the tool limit, and workers don't count toward the limit of people recording movements.

toolLimit.warning: Everything is saved, but the company has exceeded the tool limit in the {tier} plan: {count} of {limit}. The owner can switch to the {suggested} plan.
toolLimit.settings: The company has exceeded the tool limit in its plan. Nothing is blocked, but it's worth switching to the {suggested} plan.

readOnly.banner: The company is in read-only mode. The board, history and export work, but you can't save changes.
readOnly.bannerOwner: Pay the subscription or write to GP Engineering, and everything will be back. No data has been deleted.
readOnly.bannerMember: The company owner can change this. No data has been deleted.

corrections.correctHint: Set where the tool really is and what state it's in. Set found lost tools to “In use”.
corrections.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. never left, it's in the warehouse
corrections.lostHint: The system will record the date, last location and site manager.
corrections.retireHint: Broken or sold: the tool will disappear from lists, but its card and history will stay.
corrections.lostReasonPlaceholder: e.g. it's not on the site or at the Base

history.title: Movement history
history.more: Showing the {count} newest movements. Narrow the filters to see older ones; the export includes all of them.
history.exportHint: The file has two sheets: the “What's where” state and the history with these filters.

import.title: Import tools from file
import.intro: Upload an XLSX or CSV file with a list of tools: the first row is the column headers, and each next row is one tool. Before confirming you'll see a preview with errors; nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.rules: Each row needs a name and a category (name or prefix, e.g. “Młoty” (hammers) or “H”). Rows without a code get the next free code in the category. Tools without a location go to the Base. Dates in the “Następny przegląd” (next inspection) and “Gwarancja do” (warranty until) columns (e.g. 30.09.2026) become deadlines the system will remind you about a week before.

sample.hint: An XLSX with the headers we recognize and this company's categories: replace the examples with your equipment.

import.noCategories: The company has no categories yet. Add them on the board when adding a tool, before you upload the file.

fileErrors.unreadable: Couldn't read the file. Save it in Excel as .xlsx or .csv and try again.
fileErrors.empty: The file has no data rows under the headers.
fileErrors.tooMany: The file has {count} data rows, but you can import at most {max} at a time. Split it into several files.

import.mappingHint: Check which file column each tool card field comes from.
import.allValid: All rows are valid. Confirm the import to save the tools.
import.fixFile: Fix the file and upload it again. The import will only be saved when no row has an error.

rowErrors.code_invalid: Invalid code “{value}”: letters, digits and hyphens only, at most 20 characters.
rowErrors.code_repeated: Code {value} appears more than once in the file.
rowErrors.code_taken: Another tool in the company already has code {value}.
rowErrors.value_invalid: Invalid value “{value}”: enter an amount in zł, e.g. 3200 or 3200.50.
rowErrors.inspection_invalid: Invalid inspection date “{value}”: enter e.g. 30.09.2026 or 2026-09-30.
rowErrors.warranty_invalid: Invalid warranty end date “{value}”: enter e.g. 30.09.2026 or 2026-09-30.

toolsTaken.subject: {author} is taking {codes} {from}
toolsTaken.responsibility: You're no longer responsible for this equipment. You can see who has it and where it is on the “What's where” board.

subject.one: Tomorrow NarzędziownikGP switches to read-only mode
subject.many: In {days} days NarzędziownikGP switches to read-only mode

readOnlySoon.lead: Your NarzędziownikGP subscription is paid until {paidUntil}. If payment doesn't arrive by then, the company will switch to read-only mode from {from}.
readOnlySoon.effect: In this mode everyone can still see the board, history and export, but no one can save changes (movements, tools, people). No data will be deleted.
readOnlySoon.action: Once the transfer is booked, everything works right away. If you have questions, write to GP Engineering.

stickers.title: QR stickers
stickers.intro: Choose the A4 sticker sheet you have and download a PDF to print. Each sticker has a QR code, a large tool code and the company name. Scanned with a phone camera, the QR code opens the tool card, but only when you're signed in to your company.
stickers.firstPosition: First free sticker on the sheet
stickers.firstPositionHint: On a partly used sheet, enter the number of the first free sticker, counting row by row from the top left corner.
stickers.unlabeledHint: Tools that haven't had a sticker printed yet.
stickers.printUnlabeled: Download PDF: all without stickers ({count} pcs)
stickers.noUnlabeled: All tools in circulation already have printed stickers.
stickers.selectedHint: Select the tools you want to print stickers for, including reprints.
stickers.noCandidates: There are no tools in circulation. Stickers are printed only for accepted tools in circulation.
stickers.downloaded: Sticker PDF downloaded: {count} pcs. Print it at 100% scale (“Actual size”), without fitting to page.
stickers.reprintHint: Sticker damaged? Download a PDF with a single sticker and print it on a free spot on the sheet.
stickers.settingsHint: QR code stickers to put on your equipment. Without stickers: {count} pcs.

siteClosing.title: Closing site {name}
siteClosing.emptyHint: No tools in circulation are left on the site. After closing, the site disappears from the board, but its history stays.
siteClosing.confirm: Close site {name}? It can't be reopened later.
siteClosing.remainingHint: You can close the site once no tools are left on it. Return each one to the Base or transfer it to another site.
siteClosing.managerHint: If something is missing, the owner can force closing with a reason.
siteClosing.forceHint: The remaining tools ({count} pcs) will be marked as lost on this site, and {manager} will be responsible for them.
siteClosing.forceReasonPlaceholder: e.g. the client took over the site, the equipment is gone
siteClosing.forceConfirm: Mark {count} pcs as lost and close site {name}?

bell.title: Notifications
bell.empty: You don't have any notifications yet. They'll show up here, e.g. when equipment is taken from your site or vehicle, or a tool has been sitting too long.
bell.toolsTaken: The equipment is now {to} ({when}). You're no longer responsible for it.
bell.thresholdExceeded: {code} {name} has been {place} for more than {days} days
bell.thresholdExceededBody: It's been there since {since}. If it's no longer needed, return it to the Base or transfer it.
bell.movementRejectedBody: Saved on the phone {when}. {reason} Check it in the “To clarify” list.

readOnlySoon.one: Tomorrow your company switches to read-only mode
readOnlySoon.many: In {days} days your company switches to read-only mode

bell.readOnlySoonBody: Your subscription is paid until {paidUntil}. From {from} you'll see the board, history and export, but you won't be able to save changes. Pay for the subscription to keep working.
bell.readOnly: Your company is in read-only mode
bell.readOnlyOverdue: 14 days have passed since the end of the paid period ({paidUntil}). The board, history and export work, but you can't save changes. Everything comes back after payment; no data has been deleted.
bell.readOnlyManual: GP Engineering has turned on read-only mode. The board, history and export work, but you can't save changes. No data has been deleted.
bell.vehicleDeadlineBody: Vehicle details and documents are on its page.
bell.qualificationBody: Book the medical check or training in time. Details are with the person in the People directory.
bell.forgottenExitBody: Entry {when}. Without a clock-out, the record closes at midnight and won't count towards time on site.

push.title: Phone notifications
push.off: Turn them on and every new notification will also come to this phone, e.g. when someone takes equipment from your site.
push.on: Notifications are on for this phone. Every new notification will also come here.
push.failed: Couldn't change notifications. Check your signal and try again.
push.blocked: Notifications for NarzędziownikGP are blocked in your browser or phone settings. Allow them and come back here.
push.unsupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications. You'll always find them here, under notifications.
push.iosIntro: On iPhone, notifications only work in the app added to the Home Screen:
push.iosStep1: Tap “Share” (a square with an up arrow: in Safari on the bottom bar, in Chrome next to the address).
push.iosStep2: Choose “Add to Home Screen” and tap “Add”.
push.iosStep3: Open NarzędziownikGP from the Home Screen, sign in and turn on notifications here, under notifications.

installApp.title: Install the app
installApp.googlePlay: NarzędziownikGP is on Google Play. In the app, the QR scanner is faster and has a flashlight, and notifications come to your phone.
installApp.iosIntro: You'll open NarzędziownikGP from the Home Screen in its own window, without the browser bar:
installApp.iosStep1: Tap “Share” (a square with an up arrow: in Safari on the bottom bar, in Chrome next to the address).
installApp.iosStep2: Choose “Add to Home Screen” and tap “Add”.

offline.pageText: This page doesn't work without signal. The “What's where” board opens with the last downloaded data if it has been opened on this phone before, and movements saved offline will send themselves when the signal is back.
offline.pendingHint: These movements and clock-ins are saved on the phone and will send themselves when the signal is back. The time in the history will be the time they were saved.
offline.queued: No signal. Saved on the phone: {summary}. I'll send it when the connection is back.
offline.readyLabel: Suggestions from recordings ready to approve: {count}
offline.recordingQueued: No signal. The recording is on the phone; when the connection is back, I'll process it and show a suggestion to approve.

toClarify.title: To clarify
toClarify.intro: Movements saved on the phone without signal that the server didn't accept because things changed in the meantime. None of them went into the history. Check where the equipment is, record the movement again if needed, and mark it as clarified.

page.title: Reports

page.introManager: The Friday report arrives in notifications on Friday at 16:00, with the equipment on your sites and vehicles. Here you can also open it with the current state.

reports.notFound: There's no such report here. Reports arrive in notifications: the weekly one on Monday at 7:00, the Friday one on Friday at 16:00.

reports.deadlinesEmpty: No deadlines in the next {days} days.
reports.qualifications: People's qualifications in the next {days} days and overdue
reports.qualificationsEmpty: No qualifications expire in the next {days} days.
reports.fridayIntro: Equipment off Base before the weekend. Bring back to the Base whatever won't be needed on Monday.
reports.fridayEmpty: All equipment is at the Base or in service.

reports.openButton: Open the report in the app

issues.title: Issues
issues.intro: Damage, missing items and other matters for the owner. New issues, comments and closings show up here.
issues.empty: No issues yet. You can also report damaged equipment from the tool card, e.g. after scanning its sticker.

kindHint.uszkodzenie: The tool immediately gets a red “damaged” flag. It doesn't block movements.
kindHint.brak: The tool's status won't change; the owner decides whether it's lost.
kindHint.inne: Any other matter for the owner.

form.subjectHint: Choose a tool or location if the matter concerns them.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. hammer mode doesn't work, sparks when switched on
form.photoHint: Take a photo with your phone or choose one from the gallery.

details.toolWorking: The owner marked the tool as working.

comment.label: Comment
comment.placeholder: e.g. put it in the container, it goes to service tomorrow

close.title: Close issue
close.label: Closing comment
close.toolWorking: The tool is working: remove the “damaged” flag

entry.toolReportBody: {author}, {place}. Accept or reject it in issues.

issueSettings.title: Who sees issues
issueSettings.intro: The owner sees all issues, and the author sees their own. Whoever sees an issue can comment on it; a site manager can't close it.
issueSettings.siteManagers: Site manager of the location the issue concerns

supportChat.title: Support chat
supportChat.intro: Write to us (GP Engineering) when something doesn't work or you have a question. We'll reply here, and you'll get a notification on your phone.

demo.text: Chat is turned off in the demo: everyone viewing the demo uses this account, so they'd see each other's messages. For customers, each person has their own conversation with us here, with photos and a notification when we reply.
demo.contact: Have a question about NarzędziownikGP or want it for your company?

supportChat.empty: No messages yet. Tell us how we can help.

form.label: Message
form.photoHint: Your phone will shrink the photo before sending. Add a screenshot from the gallery.

supportChat.phone: Prefer to call? GP Engineering support:

push.title: GP Engineering replied in the chat

email.subject: Chat: {name} ({company}): {preview}
email.lead: New message in the support chat.
email.photo: The message has a photo attached.

admin.title: Support chat
admin.intro: User threads from all companies. Threads with new messages are at the top.

demo.title: Demo
demo.heading: See NarzędziownikGP in action
demo.lead: This is a sample construction company, “DemoBud”: dozens of tools, five sites, three vans, two service shops, nine accounts, a crew without accounts in the People directory and several weeks of history. Enter any role without signing in. On every page you can switch to another one using the bar at the top.
demo.unavailable: The demo is being refreshed right now. Try again in a few minutes.

wlasciciel.summary: Sees the whole company and keeps an eye on the money.
wlasciciel.points:
The “What's where” board with equipment value in zł and the amount off Base
Alarms: what's been on a site too long, what's lost, what's in service
Accepts tools bought by site managers, makes corrections and retirements
Sites, vans, People directory, QR stickers, Excel import and reports

kierownik.summary: Moves equipment on their sites and van.
kierownik.points:
Issuing, returns, transfers and service: by checklist, QR scanner, text or voice
A notification when someone takes equipment from their site
Reports tools bought for the site and closes their sites
Movements saved without signal send themselves when the connection is back

magazynier.summary: Runs the Base and service shops.
magazynier.points:
Issues and takes back equipment for all sites and vans
Sends tools to service and takes them back
Sees issues about missing items and damage from the crew
Full movement history with filters and Excel export

pracownik.summary: Checks where equipment is and reports problems.
pracownik.points:
Sees the board and tool cards, but doesn't record movements
Reports damage, missing items and other matters, also with a photo
Sees replies in the issue thread
Signs in with a username, no email needed

demo.tips:
As the owner: the red alarms on the board, the amount off Base and two tools waiting for acceptance.
Any tool on the board: its card with history, who moved it and when, and who's responsible for it now.
The magnifier in the header: type or say what you're looking for, e.g. “where's the level?”.
As a site manager: the “Operations” panel. Click “Issue from Base” or “Say or type” and write what you're taking, e.g. “taking two drills to Tarasy”.
Notifications (the bell) and 📋 in the header: alarms, reports and issues raised by the crew.
History: filters by site, person and tool, and export to Excel.
demo.note: This is a shared demo: other viewers can change things too, and we reset it to its starting state from time to time. Emails from the demo aren't sent anywhere.
demo.contact: Want a tool like this for your company?

welcome.title: Quick guide
welcome.text: In a few steps we'll show you what this role sees and what you can do here. You can skip it at any time and come back to it with the “Guide” button on the yellow bar.

roles.title: Switching roles
roles.text: Here you can switch roles at any time without signing in and see the same company through the eyes of the owner, site manager, storekeeper or worker.

offBase.title: Money off Base
offBase.text: Only the owner sees values in zł. This amount shows how much equipment is now on sites and vans, meaning how much could go missing.

alarms.title: Alarms
alarms.text: The red counter shows tools that have been on a site longer than the day limit (30 in the demo). They're highlighted in red on the list.

alarmTool.title: Tool card
alarmTool.text: Click any tool, e.g. one with an alarm. You'll see where it is, for how many days, who's responsible for it and its whole movement history.

search.title: Search
search.text: The magnifier in the header: type a code, name or brand and you'll instantly see where the tool is, for how many days and who's responsible for it. You can also ask by voice, e.g. “where's the level?”.

toolReports.title: To accept
toolReports.text: Site managers add tools bought on site. The owner fills in the code and value, then accepts or rejects the tool report.

operationsOwner.title: Operations
operationsOwner.text: From here you can record any equipment movement, add a tool, import a list from Excel and print QR stickers.

operationsManager.title: Operations
operationsManager.text: Record an issue from the Base, a return or a transfer with a checklist (“Issue from Base”, “Return to Base”), the QR sticker scanner or a sentence. Click “Say or type” and write e.g. “taking two drills to Tarasy”.

operationsStorekeeper.title: Running the Base
operationsStorekeeper.text: The storekeeper issues and takes back equipment for all sites and vans, sends tools to service and takes them back.

recent.title: Recent movements
recent.text: Every movement has an author and a time. You can undo your own movement within 15 minutes. The full history with filters and Excel export is under “Full history”.

recentWorker.title: Recent movements
recentWorker.text: Here you can see who moved equipment, when and where to. The full history with filters is under “Full history”.

map.title: Map
map.text: The Base, sites, vans and equipment with trackers on one map. Click a pin to see details.

lost.title: Lost
lost.text: A tool that didn't come back is marked as lost. Its card remembers where it was last and who was responsible for it.

issues.title: Issues
issues.text: Damage, missing items and other matters from the crew land here, each with a comment thread. The number on the icon shows new entries.

issuesWorker.title: Report an issue
issuesWorker.text: A worker doesn't move equipment but reports damage or missing items, also with a photo. Open the Issues page and click “New issue”.

bell.title: Notifications
bell.text: Notifications: someone took equipment from your site, a movement saved without signal needs clarifying, or a report has arrived.

menu.title: Menu
menu.text: Under the three lines you'll find all subpages: deadlines, history, QR stickers, the People directory and company settings (alarm day limit, who sees issues, service shops, subscription). You add sites and vehicles on the board.

finish.title: All set
finish.text: Click around freely, this is sample data. Also try another role on the yellow bar at the top.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.reopen: You can reopen the tutorial with the “?” sign in the header.

firstSteps.title: First steps
firstSteps.intro: Every company starts with these four things. Steps tick themselves off once the thing is already in your company.

kierownik.title: Add a site manager
kierownik.text: Create a site manager account on the “People” page. Give them the temporary password in person.

budowa.title: Add a site
budowa.text: On the board, click “Add site”, enter a name and address and choose the site manager responsible for it. If you run the site yourself, choose yourself.

narzedzia.title: Add tools
narzedzia.text: One by one with the “Add tool” button in operations on the board, or a whole list at once from an Excel file.

naklejki.title: Print QR stickers
naklejki.text: A QR code sticker on every tool: scanned with a phone, it instantly shows the card and suggests a movement.

movements.title: How to record an equipment movement

introKierownik.title: Movements on your sites
introKierownik.text: You record every move of equipment to or from your sites and vehicles in “Operations” on the board. It takes a few seconds, and the owner instantly sees what's where.

introMagazynier.title: Running the Base
introMagazynier.text: You issue and take back equipment at the Base for all sites and vehicles in the company. You record every movement in “Operations” on the board, and site managers instantly see what's coming to them.

issue.title: Issue from Base
issue.text: “Issue from Base”: select the tools that are going out and choose the site or vehicle they're going to.

return.title: Return to Base
return.text: “Return to Base”: choose the site or vehicle the equipment is coming back from and select the tools.

transferKierownik.title: Transfer
transferKierownik.text: “Transfer”: equipment goes from another site or vehicle to yours, bypassing the Base. The person taking it records it, and the site manager it came from gets a notification.

transferMagazynier.title: Transfer
transferMagazynier.text: “Transfer”: equipment goes from a site or vehicle to another site or vehicle, bypassing the Base. You can record it for any site, and the site manager it came from gets a notification.

service.title: Service
service.text: “To service” sends broken equipment to a service shop, and “From service” takes it back to the Base. Equipment in service doesn't count as equipment off Base.

summary.title: Summary before saving
summary.text: At the bottom of the form you can see what will be saved, e.g. “S-01, H-03 → Rataje”. Check it and click “Confirm ✓”. Only then does the movement go into the history.

undo.title: Undo within 15 minutes
undo.text: Made a mistake? Undo your own movement with the “Undo” button right after saving or in “Recent movements”, for 15 minutes. The original stays in the history as undone.

scan.title: QR scanner
scan.text: “Scan QR”: scan the stickers on the tools with your phone camera, several in a row. We'll suggest the type of movement based on where the equipment is now.

voice.title: By voice or a sentence
voice.text: Click “Say or type”, hold “Hold and speak” and say e.g. “taking two grinders to Rataje”. We'll show what we understood, and nothing is saved until you confirm ✓.

typing.title: With a plain sentence
typing.text: Click “Type text” and write e.g. “taking two grinders to Rataje”. We'll show what we understood, and nothing is saved until you confirm ✓.

finish.title: All set
finish.text: That's everything you need day to day. The tutorial didn't save anything: movements only appear when you confirm them yourself.

legal.draft: Draft document. The content is awaiting legal review and may change before the agreement is concluded.
legal.settingsHint: Terms of service, privacy policy and the agreement for processing your people's personal data, plus a page on how to request account deletion. Useful when you inform your workers about how their data is processed.

cookies.title: Cookies.
cookies.text: We use essential cookies to make the app work and, with your consent, Google Analytics to understand how people use the site. You can change your consent at any time in the footer.

costs.title: Equipment cost
costs.exportHint: A file for the selected period, e.g. for settling with the client.
costs.empty: There was no equipment here in this period.
costs.emptyWhole: There hasn't been any equipment here yet.
costs.noRateHint: Days without a rate aren't included in the amount: the tool has no value, and the rate is a percentage of the value. Add a value or a daily amount on the tool card.
costs.noRateHintManager: Days without a rate aren't included in the amount: the tool has no value, and the rate is a percentage of the value. The owner adds the value or daily amount on the tool card.
costs.rule: Every started day on which the tool was here, even briefly, counts (the transfer day counts at both places). A mistake in the days is fixed with a correction on the tool card.
costs.startHint: Equipment cost is days on site times the daily rate. Set the company rate as a percentage of the tool's value per day; we suggest 1% to start. A rate set for the first time applies retroactively to the whole movement history, so you'll immediately see the cost of ongoing and finished sites.
costs.startManager: The owner hasn't set a daily rate yet, so there are no equipment costs yet.

costSummary.title: Equipment costs
costSummary.intro: Equipment cost of every site and vehicle in the selected period. Open a site or vehicle to see the tools.
costSummary.introManager: Equipment cost of your sites and vehicles in the selected period. Open a site or vehicle to see the tools.
costSummary.empty: No sites or vehicles to show in this period.
costSummary.exportHint: A file for the selected period, e.g. for your accountant.
costSummary.startSettings: Set a daily rate in settings
costSummary.sheetTitle: Equipment costs of sites and vehicles

timeOnSite.title: Time on site
timeOnSite.intro: Hours of each person on each site and the Base in a month, from clock-ins on site posters.
timeOnSite.introManager: Hours of people on your sites in a month, from clock-ins on site posters.
timeOnSite.introOwn: Your clock-ins and time on site this month and last month. If something doesn't add up, tell the site manager.
timeOnSite.rule: Time counts from entry to exit. A clock-in without an exit doesn't count until someone fills in the exit, and the break between an exit and the next entry (e.g. travel) doesn't count anywhere. Switching to another site with one scan ends the stay at the previous one at the moment of that scan.
timeOnSite.empty: No one has clock-ins with an exit this month.
timeOnSite.emptyOwn: You have no clock-ins this month.
timeOnSite.exportHint: A file for the month, e.g. for your accountant: hours with two decimal places.
timeOnSite.withoutExitNote: Clock-ins without an exit that don't count: {count}
timeOnSite.sheetRule: Hours from entry to exit, from clock-ins. Clock-ins without an exit don't count.

dailyRates.title: Daily rates
dailyRates.hint: Equipment cost on a site or vehicle is days times the daily rate: the tool's own amount, or otherwise a percentage of value for the category or the company.
dailyRates.startHint: Rates and values saved today apply retroactively to the whole movement history. Every later change applies from the day of the change.
dailyRates.startedHint: Costs are calculated from {day} back through the whole history. A change of rate or value applies from the day of the change, so closed months don't change.
dailyRates.companyPercent: Company rate (% of value per day)
dailyRates.companyPercentHint: We suggest 1% to start: a tool worth 2000 zł then costs 20 zł per day on site.
dailyRates.categoriesHint: Empty field: the category uses the company rate.
dailyRates.invalidPercent: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100, with at most two decimal places.
dailyRates.invalidAmount: Enter an amount in zł, with at most two decimal places.
dailyRates.toolRateNone: none: set a daily rate in settings
dailyRates.toolRateNoValue: {percent}% of value per day, but the tool has no value
dailyRates.toolOwnHint: An amount in zł per day instead of a percentage of value. Empty field: the tool uses the category or company rate. The change applies from today.

idleLogout.title: Sign out when idle
idleLogout.intro: On an office computer, someone could sit down at the open app. Choose how long without mouse, keyboard or touch activity before the owner's browser signs out.
idleLogout.label: Sign out owner
idleLogout.hint: Applies only to owner accounts. Site managers, storekeepers and workers stay signed in on their phones, also without signal. With sign-out on, the owner's board isn't kept on the phone for viewing offline.
idleLogout.signedOut: We signed you out after inactivity, as set by your company. Sign in again.

language.title: Language
language.intro: The app language for your account. The change applies only to you: other people in the company see their own language.
language.demoIntro: In the demo, the language is saved only in this browser, because many people use the demo accounts at once.
language.label: App language
language.invalid: Choose a language from the list.

costSettings.title: Who sees costs
costSettings.intro: The owner sees the costs of all sites and vehicles. The storekeeper and workers never see them.
costSettings.siteManagers: Site managers see the costs of their sites and vehicles
costSettings.siteManagersHint: A site manager will see the “Costs” tab and the summary only for locations they manage. The tool's value can be worked out from a percentage rate. Only the owner still sets the rates.

locationPage.siteEmpty: There's no equipment on this site right now.
locationPage.vehicleEmpty: There's no equipment in this vehicle right now.
locationPage.baseEmpty: There's no equipment at the Base right now.
locationPage.vehicleDeadlinesEmptyOwner: Add liability insurance (OC), comprehensive insurance (AC), vehicle inspection, tachograph calibration or a custom deadline, e.g. a tyre change. You and the vehicle's manager will get a reminder in notifications: 30 days before for OC, AC and tachograph, a week before for the inspection and custom deadlines.
locationPage.vehicleDocumentsHint: Only the owner and the vehicle's manager can see vehicle deadline documents.

rentals.intro: Equipment from a rental company goes straight onto the board, without acceptance. The app calculates its cost from the daily rate and reminds you to return it to the rental company a day before the return date. It doesn't count towards your subscription's tool limit.
rentals.noPlaces: You don't have an active site or vehicle where you can receive rented equipment.
rentals.noCategories: The company doesn't have any tool categories yet. Ask the owner to add categories.
rentals.dailyRateHint: The amount from the agreement for each started day.
rentals.added: Received {code} {name}: {place}. You can print a sticker in Stickers if needed.
rentals.cardReturned: Returned to the rental company. It stays in the history.
rentals.cardExtendHint: Extending the rental: change the return date in the deadlines below.
rentals.returnHint: The equipment will disappear from the board, and the history will keep when and who recorded the return. You can undo a mistake within 15 minutes on the board.
rentals.returnConfirm: Record the return of {code} to the rental company?

punches.title: Clock-in
punches.cameraHint: Point the camera at the QR code on the site poster.
punches.notPoster: This isn't a site poster code.
punches.confirmExit: Are you finishing on this site?
punches.flagged: For the site manager to clarify: {check}.
punches.privacy: The app checks the phone's location only at the moment you scan the poster and doesn't track it in the background. It doesn't save where you're standing, only the distance from the site.
punches.exitMissing: Exit: no exit, closed at midnight
punches.timeOnSiteMissing: Doesn't count towards time on site until someone fills in the exit.
punches.correctHint: Enter the real entry or exit time and the reason. The previous time stays in the clock-in history.
punches.correctNothing: Change the entry or exit time.
punches.presentEmpty: No one is clocked in here right now.
punches.historyEmpty: No one has clocked in here yet.
punches.posterHint: Print the poster and hang it at the entrance or by the container. Everyone with an account in the app scans it when arriving and leaving, and after scanning, the site manager can also clock in people without a phone.
punches.renewConfirm: The old poster will stop working and you'll need to hang a new one. Change the code?
punches.renewed: Code changed. Download and hang the new poster.
punches.notPositioned: no location on the sites map, so clock-ins aren't checked
punches.radiusHint: From {min} to {max} m. A clock-in further from the site will be saved marked “off site”.
punches.toClarifyIntroOwner: Clock-ins off site, without phone location, on a site without location, and without an exit (closed at midnight). Decide whether everything is fine: fill in or correct the times with a reason and mark the clock-in as clarified.
punches.toClarifyIntroManager: Clock-ins on your sites that are off site, without phone location, not checked, or without an exit (closed at midnight). You can fill in or correct times with a reason, including for people you clock in. The owner corrects your own clock-ins, and clarifies both your own and those you make for others.
punches.posterHeading: Clock in when you arrive and when you leave
punches.posterStep1: Scan the QR code with your phone camera or with the “Clock in” button on the board in NarzędziownikGP. Without a camera, enter the code printed under the QR code.
punches.posterStep2: The first scan saves your entry. When leaving, scan the code again and confirm “Are you finishing on this site?”. A scan on another site saves a switch.
punches.posterStep3: The app checks the phone's location only at the moment of the scan and saves only the distance from the site, not where you're standing.
punches.queuedEntry: No signal. Entry saved on the phone: {place}, {time}. I'll send it when the connection is back.
punches.queuedExit: No signal. Exit saved on the phone: {place}, {time}. I'll send it when the connection is back.
punches.queuedTransfer: No signal. Switch saved on the phone: {place}, {time}. I'll send it when the connection is back.
punches.queuedPrivacy: The phone's location at the time of the scan stays only on the phone. After sending, the app will save only the distance from the site, not the scan location.
punches.conflictsIntro: Scans saved on the phone without signal that didn't match clock-ins saved in the meantime, so they didn't count towards time on site. Check with the person what happened and mark them as clarified.
punches.conflictExit: exit confirmed with “Are you finishing on this site?”

conflictReasons.kod_niewazny: the poster code no longer works (new code or a poster from another company)
conflictReasons.budowa_zakonczona: the site was finished before the scan arrived
conflictReasons.pozniejsze_odbicie: a later clock-in for this person was saved in the meantime
conflictReasons.nie_odbity_tu: exit, but the person wasn't clocked in here
conflictReasons.juz_odbity_tu: entry, but the person was already clocked in here
conflictReasons.osoba_nieaktywna: the person is no longer active in the directory

punches.peopleHint: Select people from the directory who don't have a phone or account. The app will check your phone's location and record who clocked them in.
punches.peopleOfflineHint: List from the last clock-in with signal.
punches.peopleAlreadyHere: {name}: someone clocked this person in here in the meantime. Scan the poster again to clock their exit.
punches.peopleNotHere: {name}: someone clocked this person in somewhere else in the meantime, so I didn't save the exit. Scan the poster again.
punches.peopleQueued: No signal. Clock-ins for {count} people saved on the phone: {place}, {time}. I'll send them when the connection is back.
